title: What's a Flower Doing on the Roof?

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — WHAT'S THAT DOING HERE? (WD-01 to WD-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A yellow flower is growing out of the top of a villager's roof: let it grow, or move it to the ground.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A flower is growing out of the top of (name1)'s roof. A real, living flower, bright yellow, rooted right in the thatch. A seed must have blown up there, and with the rain and the sun, it has decided to make a go of it. It's actually rather beautiful.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) climbs up and carefully digs it out with a little bit of thatch, and plants it by the door. It droops for a day, then perks up. (name1) waters it every morning. (He/She) likes having it where (he/she) can see it. Sometimes, though, (he/she) glances up at the roof, just to check another hasn't started.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (name1) decides the flower can stay. It grows taller. Another one appears next to it. By the end of the season, (name1)'s roof has a small yellow garden on top, and bees visit it, and children point at it. (name1) is extremely proud of a garden (he/she) did absolutely nothing to plant.
